hero.headline: I see a future shaped by innovation at MO.
hero.subheadline: I'm thrilled about MO's mission to advance digital government. The prospect of impacting federal growth through AI and modern tech excites me. Working at a company that values integrity and curiosity aligns perfectly with my values.

whyCompany.title: MO's focus on AI innovation
whyCompany.body: MO's ability to transform government functions through AI aligns with my passion for tech-driven solutions. It's inspiring to see a company driving sustainable change with advanced tools.

whyCompany.title: Growth in the GovCon sector
whyCompany.body: The current expansion in government contracting is a pivotal moment. Joining MO right now offers a chance to contribute to groundbreaking developments in federal technology.

whyCompany.title: Skills gained as BDR transfer well
whyCompany.body: My experience in business development at Copygen.ai and as a digital marketing intern equips me with research and CRM skills. These are crucial for aiding MO's growth objectives.

quote: I want to propel federal tech forward with MO, leveraging both AI and innovative business strategies. Joining MO means making a difference where it truly matters.
